name: Sedra Student Design Centre (SDC)
description: Over 20,000 square feet dedicated to Waterloo engineering student design and competition teams (Formula Motorsports, Midnight Sun Solar Car, Rocketry, Robotics, Submarine, Clean Snowmobile, Concrete Toboggan). Features assembly bays, testing cells, and collaborative mezzanine.
hours: 24/7 access for authorized team members; Staffed hours 08:30–16:30 M–F

name: Engineering Student Machine Shop
description: Comprehensive student fabrication shop featuring CNC milling centers, manual lathes, vertical band saws, surface grinders, welding booths, and precision metrology inspection.

name: Rapid Prototyping Centre (RPC)
description: State-of-the-art additive manufacturing facility with commercial FDM/SLA 3D printers, laser cutting, and rapid design iteration equipment serving coursework, capstone design, and research projects.

name: Gear Computer Lab
description: Primary MME student computing facility equipped with 50+ high-performance dual-boot workstations running engineering software: SolidWorks, ANSYS Mechanical & Fluent, MATLAB, Abaqus, AutoCAD, and NX.
hours: 24/7 access with WatCard for enrolled engineering students

name: Department Lecture Hall E5-3101
description: 114-seat tiered lecture hall with dual high-definition laser projectors, Crestron touch AV control, document camera, assistive listening, and lecture capture.

name: Department Lecture Hall E5-3102
description: 118-seat tiered multimedia lecture hall equipped with multi-screen projection, podium mic, wireless presentation gateway, and wheelchair accessible seating rows.

name: Seminar & Presentation Room E5-3052
description: 20-seat executive seminar and graduate defense conference room equipped with dual video conferencing displays, integrated boundary microphones, and digital interactive smartboard.

name: Systems Design Teaching Laboratory (E5-6005)
description: Dedicated laboratory facility for Systems Design and Biomedical Engineering courses, containing sensor test benches, biomechanical measurement apparatus, and group experiment stations.

name: Systems Design Electronics Workshop (E5-6012)
description: Undergraduate design workshop studio equipped with digital oscilloscopes, arbitrary function generators, regulated DC power supplies, temperature-controlled soldering irons, and SMD rework tools.

name: Systems Design Undergraduate Workshop (E5-6013)
description: Mechanical prototyping studio for Systems Design fourth-year capstone design teams and coursework projects, featuring assembly benches, hand tools, drill presses, and material prep.

name: Engineering 3 (E3) Pedestrian Bridge Link
description: Glass-enclosed pedestrian bridge over Ring Road and the ION LRT tracks connecting E5 Level 3 to Engineering 3. (Note: Accessibility documents contain conflicting references citing Level 3 vs Level 5; physical drawing 053E5_03FLR verifies Level 3 connection corridor 3818).

name: Dean of Engineering Executive Suite & Boardroom
description: Executive administrative offices for the Dean of Engineering, Associate Deans (Undergraduate, Graduate, Research), and Faculty of Engineering Council Boardroom.

name: All-Gender Multi-Stall Washrooms (E5 2901 & 2902)
description: Fully accessible all-gender multi-stall washroom facilities located centrally on the 2nd floor off the main corridor.

name: Level 3 Collaborative Study Commons (E5 3812A)
description: Open-access student collaborative study space overlooking the central atrium with charging ports and movable seating.
